summary.text: Wait for an invitation if you have insufficient MediSave, then follow the application details in the letter.

details.heading: What APS helps with
details.body: Additional Premium Support provides financial assistance to members who cannot afford their MediShield Life and/or CareShield Life premiums after premium subsidies and MediSave use, and have limited family support.

steps.name: Wait for an invitation
steps.text: If you have insufficient MediSave, you will be invited to apply for APS. You do not need to apply ahead of time.

items: You will be invited to apply if you have insufficient MediSave.
There is no need to apply for APS ahead of time.

steps.name: Follow the letter
steps.text: Use the application details in your invitation letter to apply for APS.

items: The invitation letter includes details on the application process.
